description: Bus Stops (Assets) is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Casey. This dataset provides the locations of the Bus Stop Assets that are located in the City of Casey, extracted from the City of Casey's Asset Management System and GIS databases. Coverage: City of Casey. The portal files it under the publisher City of Casey. Its tags are assets, bus, bus-stop, community, infrastructure. It offers 6 resource(s) in csv, geojson, json, kml, shp. The portal shows 2024-08-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
